rationale: Evaluating prevention of unintended braking requires characterising braking behaviour itself and its relationship to a braking need. H-3 establishes sudden stopping without an obstacle as the hazardous event, while SG-3 and FR-7 support distinguishing unintended braking from braking needed to avoid obstacle collisions. P stays within the declared operational situation without incorporating sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Whether braking occurs” directly addresses the behaviour targeted by SG-3 and the hazardous event in H-3.
“Whether it is justified by an obstacle or collision-avoidance need” captures the relationship supported by H-3 and FR-7, rather than the mechanisms used to determine that need.
The declared scope matches H-3: straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
P includes vehicle braking behaviour as the subject of evaluation, not ancillary controller, sensor, warning, or redundancy behaviour.
